cc:Work.dc:title: Interleaved complete-response latency
cc:Work.dc:description: Median of three observations for each case and model, then median across the same complete cases for every model. Only the new serial interleaved session is shown; no old or concurrent bulk latencies are pooled. Point summaries do not imply cross-day precision.
